reason: A CLI tool for packaging, installing, and removing agent skills, rules, and MCP configuration across multiple AI coding harnesses.

summaries.zh: 用于将智能体技能、规则和 MCP 配置打包，并安装或移除到多种 AI 编程运行环境中。
summaries.en: A CLI tool for packaging agent skills, rules, and MCP configuration, then installing or removing them across supported AI coding harnesses.

capabilities: Packages skills, rules, and MCP configuration into agent-pack archives
Installs agent-pack configuration into project or global harness configuration
Removes installed configuration using an install ledger
